purpose: Describe an action from the perspective of its receiver.
keywords: Godan a-stem + れる; ichidan stem + られる; する → される; 来る → 来られる.
I was praised by the teacher.
This book is read by many people.
I got caught in the rain during the trip.
formation: Godan a-stem + れる; ichidan stem + られる; する → される; 来る → 来られる.
restrictions: Japanese also uses indirect passives for events affecting someone.
mistake: Mark the agent appropriately, often with に; られる can have other meanings.
